;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack]], [[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**Two [[Saudi Aramco]] oil refineries, one in [[Abqaiq]] and one in [[Khurais oil field|Khurais]], [[Saudi Arabia]], are attacked by [[Unmanned Aerial Vehicle|drones]], resulting in massive fires. The fires are under control, according to the [[Ministry of Interior (Saudi Arabia)|Saudi Arabian Interior Ministry]]. [[Houthi movement|Houthi militants]] claim responsibility, saying that they used 10 drones for the attack. [https://www.euronews.com/2019/09/14/drone-attacks-on-saudi-aramco-facilities-saudi-media (Euronews)]
**According to [[Al Jazeera Media Network|Al Jazeera]], Saudi Aramco's exports and oil production are disrupted by 5 million barrels of oil a day, half of the entire Saudi Arabian oil exports. [https://twitter.com/AJABreaking/status/1172859916437950464 (Al Jazeera)] [https://twitter.com/AJABreaking/status/117286054028220006 (Al Jazeera)]

*A charity ship, carrying 82 migrants rescued off the coast of [[Libya]], is offered docking at the [[Italy|Italian]] island of [[Lampedusa]].
